name: Bookie
brief: The Business Central extension for the Bookie accounting portal: exact balances, amounts due and payments, and Bitcoin wallets as bank accounts
description: One extension for the Bookie accounting portal (getbook.ie). Core: the custom API api/knowallBookie/bookie/v1.0 with bank balances and bank ledger entries, customer and vendor ledger entries with remaining amounts, posted payments, financial report lines, company setup, and customer payment registration. Bitcoin: a watch-only wallet descriptor per bank account, kept in its own table and readable only with BOOKIE BTC READ, published at api/bookie/bitcoin/v1.0/bitcoinWallets.
